With a footprint spanning the USA, UK, and Europe, they partner with industry leaders to engineer sophisticated platforms for sports wagering, prize-based systems, and complex market simulation environments . Their vision is to lead the evolution of interactive technology through intelligent, data-driven architecture that ensures seamless user experiences. The firm is driven by a culture of teamwork, transparency, and technical excellenc The role You will help shape and drive how the firm builds and operates reliable, observable, secure, and cost-efficient systems on AWS . Working closely with development, platform, and incident management teams, you will define reliability in measurable terms and build the tooling and processes to achieve it, improving platform speed, stability, and scalability. Key responsibilities Partner with engineering teams to define, measure, and manage SLOs/SLIs, using error budgets to guide delivery decisions. Enhance observability across services (metrics, logs, traces) to detect and resolve issues proactively. Lead cost optimisation: monitor spend, right-size workloads, tune autoscaling, and improve infrastructure efficiency. Improve production readiness via pre-deployment checks, post-release validation, and robust platform guardrails. Introduce and run chaos engineering experiments to strengthen resilience and recovery. Automate operational processes to reduce manual intervention and toil across the stack. Support major incident response, root-cause analysis, and continual improvement actions. Collaborate cross-functionally to raise standards for stability, security, performance, and compliance. Required Skills & Experience 3+ years’ experience in SRE, Platform, or DevOps roles within production environments. Strong Kubernetes operational experience (on-prem and AWS EKS). Hands-on experience defining and operating SLOs/SLIs, alerting, and incident workflows. Deep understanding of observability and telemetry (monitoring, logging, tracing). Infrastructure as Code with Terraform; experience with GitOps workflows and CI/CD. Scripting proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go. Proven ability to balance cost efficiency with reliability and performance. Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively across multiple teams. Strong Desirables for this role Experience running chaos engineering experiments. Exposure to high-throughput, low-latency systems. FinOps knowledge or cost management practices. AWS certifications (e.g., Solutions Architect, DevOps Engineer)

review_candidates.title: Receptionist
review_candidates.description: Company Description Beacon FinTrain is a global financial training provider known for integrity, customer focus, team effectiveness, and accountability. For more than 15 years, the organization has delivered world-class financial trainings and workshops for leading companies, supporting both employee development and financial consulting needs. Beacon FinTrain is an authorized learning partner of AFP, FMI, and Frankfurt School of Finance, offering programs such as CTP, FP&A, CFM, CFA, ACI-DC, and IFRS. The company has modernized its classroom and live online learning systems to meet the evolving requirements of today’s professionals. Team members join a mission-driven environment committed to high-quality education and professional growth. Role Description The Receptionist role at Beacon FinTrain is a full-time, on-site position based in Qesm El Maadi. Key Responsibilities: • Organize meetings, appointments, schedules, and databases for the CVO and Top Management. • Manage and follow up on travel arrangements, including transportation and accommodation. • Prepare presentations, reports, and required business documents. • Coordinate company events, conferences, and related preparations. • Manage the office's daily administrative and domestic logistics. • Supervise and follow up with facilities and office support staff. • Monitor assigned tasks, ensure deadlines are met, and follow up on deliverables. • Follow up on the overall business operational cycle. • Implement and maintain office policies and procedures. • Ensure proper office opening and closing procedures. • Attend senior management meetings when required. • Support Top Management with key business functions, record-keeping, and interview coordination. • Manage and maintain all company mobile lines and numbers across Egypt and KSA, including coordinating with telecom network providers, monitoring active lines, packages, usage, renewals, and resolving any related issues. • Act as the main point of contact with mobile network providers in Egypt and KSA and ensure effective management of corporate mobile services. • Maintain accurate records of company mobile lines, assigned employees, SIM cards, packages, and related telecom documentation. • Be flexible and available for internal or external travel when required. Requirements:- • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration or a related field. • 3- 5 years of proven experience in business administration or office management. • Good knowledge of business administration and office management functions. • Experience dealing with telecommunication/mobile network providers is preferred. • Excellent interpersonal and time-management skills. • Excellent command of English and strong business writing skills. • High level of reliability, confidentiality, and discretion. • Presentable with excellent communication and negotiation skills. • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work effectively with senior management.

review_candidates.title: Product Support Engineer II
review_candidates.description: Job Description As a Product Support Engineer here at Honeywell, you will play a vital role in providing technical support for our sensing products and solutions, ensuring optimal performance and customer satisfaction. You will collaborate closely with Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Sales and Customer Service to resolve product issues and drive continuous improvement. You will report directly to our Tech Support Manager and you’ll work out of our Richardson, TX or Houston, TX location on a Hybrid work schedule. In this role, you will impact the success of our Sensing Solutions business by delivering expert product support, enhancing product reliability, and contributing to the advancement of technologies that serve critical industry applications. Responsibilities Provide technical support and troubleshooting for sensing products used in industrial applications. Develop and maintain product documentation and training materials to support internal teams and customers. Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Engineering, Quality, and Manufacturing to resolve product issues and implement corrective actions. Support cross-functional teams on product development projects, providing insights about customers’ needs based on day-to-day interactions with customers. Qualifications YOU MUST HAVE Bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution in a technical discipline such as science, technology, engineering, mathematics Minimum 3 years of experience in product support or engineering roles, in industries like Healthcare, Transportation or Aerospace & Defense Strong knowledge of sensing technologies and product lifecycle support Experience with troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and implementing corrective actions for complex products WE VALUE Advanced degree in Engineering, preferably Electrical or Electro-mechanical Engineering Proficiency in product data management and support tools such as Salesforce and/or Teamcenter Strong project management, problem-solving and data analysis skills with a continuous improvement mindset Experience working with cross-functional teams in a fast-paced environment U.s. Person Requirements Due to compliance with U.S. export control laws and regulations, candidate must be a U.S. Person, which is defined as, a U.S. citizen, a U.S. permanent resident, or have protected status in the U.S. under asylum or refugee status or have the ability to obtain an export authorization. Benefits Of Working For Honeywell In addition to a performance-driven salary, cutting-edge work, and developing solutions side-by-side with dedicated experts in their fields, Honeywell employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package. This package includes employer-subsidized Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance; Short-Term and Long-Term Disability; 401(k) match, Flexible Spending Accounts, Health Savings Accounts, EAP, and Educational Assistance; Parental Leave, Paid Time Off (for vacation, personal business, sick time, and parental leave), and 12 Paid Holidays. For more information visit: Benefits at Honeywell The application period for the job is estimated to be 40 days from the job posting date; however, this may be shortened or extended depending on business needs and the availability of qualified candidates. Posting Date : 8/4/2026 About Honeywell Technologies Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial, and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions, and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy. THE BUSINESS UNIT Honeywell Industrial Automation (IA) is a leading provider of integrated automation and software solutions, control systems, and services for the process industries. Our solutions help customers improve productivity, reduce costs, and minimize downtime. We are dedicated to delivering innovative solutions that enable our customers to achieve their business objectives and drive sustainable growth. review_candidates.title: Procurement Manager
review_candidates.description: We are looking for a Service Procurement Manager to develop and execute annual category strategies for Hard FM (HVAC, chiller overhauls, generators, medium/low-voltage switchgear, BMS/automation, elevators, fire-protection systems) and Soft FM (security, janitorial, façade cleaning, pest control, waste management, fleet operations). Key Accountabilities: Strategic Sourcing & Category Management Develop and execute annual category strategies for Hard FM (HVAC, chiller overhauls, generators, medium/low-voltage switchgear, BMS/automation, elevators, fire-protection systems) and Soft FM (security, janitorial, façade cleaning, pest control, waste management, fleet operations). Build and maintain a qualified, audited, and compliant vendor matrix across critical and non-critical service categories. Continuously monitor supply market trends, wage rate benchmarks, indexation formulas, and contractor cost drivers to optimize total cost of ownership (TCO). Tendering, Bidding & Commercial Evaluation Lead end-to-end RFP/RFQ/ITT processes: technical scope alignment, bill of quantities (BOQ) review, commercial proposal evaluation, and bidder benchmarking. Coordinate with Operations and Technical teams to ensure Statements of Work (SOW) include well-defined deliverables, performance regimes, response/rectification times, and measurable Service Level Agreements (SLAs). Conduct rigorous total-cost analyses, rate-card comparisons, and cost-breakdown validations (direct labor, materials markups, overheads, profit margins). Contract Drafting, Negotiation & Governance Formulate, negotiate, and finalize service contracts, Master Service Agreements (MSAs), and Long-Term Agreements (LTAs) in coordination with Legal and Risk teams. Embed robust commercial and operational safeguards: liquidated damages (LDs), SLA penalty/bonus structures, performance guarantees, back-to-back client liability clauses, termination rights, and parent-company guarantees. Manage contract life cycles: scope variations, claims resolution, annual escalations/indexations, and extension renewals. Supplier Performance & Relationship Management (SRM) Establish KPI scorecards and audit frameworks to review subcontractor performance on safety, quality, staffing levels, SLA achievement, and regulatory compliance. Lead quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with strategic contractors and drive performance improvement plans (PIPs) for underperforming vendors. Manage conflict resolution, claim mitigation, and contractual default procedures smoothly without operational disruptions. Compliance, QHSE & Risk Management Enforce strict HSE and labor regulation standards across all subcontracts, verifying valid certifications, insurance coverage (Third-Party Liability, Workmen’s Compensation), and local statutory compliance. Oversee fraud prevention, ethics policies, conflict-of-interest declarations, and transparent audit trails in line with corporate governance frameworks. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) Cost Savings & Value Creation: Achieved annual cost avoidance and bottom-line savings against budget and category baseline. SLA & Performance Adherence: Subcontractor SLA compliance rate (>95%) and timely close-out of service work orders. Procurement Cycle Time: On-time execution of sourcing cycles from requisition receipt to award/contract execution. Contract Coverage: Percentage of recurring spend managed under formalized MSAs/framework agreements (>85%). Supplier Compliance & Safety: Zero serious HSE non-compliances or statutory breaches by managed service contractors. Job Requirements & Qualifications: Minimum 4: 7 years of progressive experience in procurement, with at least 3+ years specifically leading service procurement, SLA drafting and contract management in a head or lead capacity managing the operations, maintenance & Services for one of the following brands (Ex. Daiken - KONE - LG - Caterpillar...) Bachelor's degree in a relevant Strategic sourcing: proven track record in supplier evaluation, spend analysis, commercial negotiations, and category management for services System proficiency: Hands-on experience with ERP/ E-Procurement systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle) and advanced analytics tols Professional certification such as CIPS or CPSM highly desirable Very good English both written & spoken
